open_issues: SKIM lateral (y, along the edge line) excursions in the live run: min -0.27 mm at 5.86 s (SKIM start, the 0 -> 25 mm/s along-track acceleration, before any material contact) and max +0.14 mm at 7.56 s (the geometric stop at the SKIM end, after the dome); while the blade cuts dome material (6.3-7.4 s) |y| <= 0.03 mm, and over the armed contact steps |y| <= 0.14 mm. Edge height z stays within -0.037..+0.035 mm over the whole SKIM. The unit-test cross-track criterion (<= 0.1 mm on the fitted plant) is a model result; live y exceeds it at the along-track velocity transients. A ramped start (acceleration limit) would be the next refinement.

The blade lowest point clears the bar top by only +0.013 mm during SKIM (by design: edge at target + 0.2 mm with the 10 deg double bevel); a larger edge clearance or a single-bevel blade would add margin.

The goal evaluator's move window is the planned reference schedule [13.2, 18.86] s; the live controller ran ~0.24 s late ([13.44, 19.1] s measured). Both windows PASS; the live verdict uses the planned one.
path_v3 adds ~2.4 s to the plan (geometric stops, 1 mm presettle hold 0.5 s); duration 28 s.
The chip falls off the board onto the table (kinematic preflight and live): a catch tray / bin is not modelled.
Quality-only: maximum_gouge_depth_m reported 0.02 m in the kinematic preflight surface metric after the chip left (surface sampling at the bar end); not part of any verdict.
